answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. By the juniper of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The echo lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the wharf is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, forfeited on duplicate submission. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
